answer: Tie each voting seat to an onyx hardware root that must sign timed challenges, then reject any identity whose story is only a fable of reused logs or identical probe answers. When a gale of new keys appears with the same latency and the same transcripts, the protocol freezes their ballots and seizes a posted bond. Honest agents keep one rooted seat; mass-produced aliases fail the uniqueness check before they can swing an epoch.
